target.title: fix(gateway,tui): queue-mode busy guard + queued-turn cancel contract
target.body:
Fixes #89059
Fixes #90012

## What Problem This Solves

The TUI `sendMessage` / submit gates blocked mid-run prompts regardless of session `/queue` mode, so `followup`, `collect`, and `interrupt` never reached Gateway queue handling.

Separately, once a mid-run prompt *was* forwarded, Gateway could enqueue it and terminalize the original `chat.send` before the queued turn started. The client lost a usable abort target, so Esc/`/stop` could report completion while the queued prompt still executed. Maintainer review required a Gateway-owned, owner-aware queued-turn cancellation contract before merge (not retain-controller-across-wait, not whole-queue clear).

## Summary

Two related gaps fixed together:

1. **TUI busy guard** respects session queue mode and forwards non-`steer` mid-run sends (plus `/queue` directives).
2. **Gateway cancel contract**: queued followup/collect turns keep an abortable identity after `chat.send` settles; session abort cancels authorized queued turns **first**, then active runs.

## Changes

### Gateway-owned queued-turn cancellation

- Add `chatQueuedTurns` registry (`src/gateway/chat-queued-turns.ts`) for cancel identities that are **not** active chat-send runs (no active projection / timeout ownership).
- `chat.send` registers via `queuedFollowupLifecycle.onEnqueued` and completes via `onComplete`.
- Followup runs always receive an `abortSignal` so drain drops aborted items.
- `chat.abort` by `runId` cancels queued turns when no longer active.
- Session `chat.abort` cancels authorized queued turns first, then active runs (avoids drain promotion races).
- Authorization reuses active-run owner rules (conn/device/admin). No whole-queue clear as multi-owner stop.

### TUI queue-mode forwarding

- Propagate `queueMode` on session row / TUI state.
- Soft-open busy guard for non-`steer` modes; `/queue` directives bypass active-run guard.
- Preserve `activeChatRunId` when a queued followup send fails.
- Esc / explicit stop (`preferActive`) uses **session-scoped** `chat.abort` so lost local run ids cannot leave queued work running.

## Evidence

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
    src/gateway/chat-queued-turns.test.ts \
    src/gateway/server-methods/chat.abort-authorization.test.ts \
    src/tui/tui-command-handlers.test.ts \
    src/tui/tui-session-actions.test.ts \
    src/tui/tui.test.ts
 ✓ gateway suites green (queued cancel registry + chat.abort ownership/order)
 ✓ tui suites green (181 tests: queue-mode busy guard + session abort expectations)
$ node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs \
    src/gateway/chat-queued-turns.ts \
    src/gateway/server-methods/chat.ts \
    src/tui/tui-session-actions.ts \
    src/tui/gateway-chat.ts \
    src/tui/embedded-backend.ts \
    src/tui/tui-backend.ts
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.
```

Authorization tests cover: abort queued-by-runId after active registration is gone; reject foreign-owner queued abort; session abort cancels queued before active; foreign owner cannot clear another requester's queued turns.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: TUI blocked non-steer mid-run sends; after forwarding, cancel had no Gateway identity for queued turns so Esc could miss still-queued prompts.
Real environment tested: macOS, Node 22, OpenClaw branch `fix/tui-queue-mode-busy-guard` at commit with Gateway cancel contract.
Exact steps or command run after this patch:

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/chat-queued-turns.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/chat.abort-authorization.test.ts src/tui/tui-command-handlers.test.ts src/tui/tui-session-actions.test.ts src/tui/tui.test.ts
# gateway + tui suites green
$ node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/gateway/chat-queued-turns.ts src/gateway/server-methods/chat.ts src/tui/tui-session-actions.ts
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.
```

Evidence after fix: Unit/integration tests for owner-aware queued cancel, ordered session abort, and TUI queue-mode forwarding all pass; oxlint clean on touched files. Docs updated in `docs/concepts/queue.md` (Queued-turn cancellation).
Observed result after fix: `chat.abort` can cancel a queued turn by runId when active controllers no longer hold it; session abort returns queued run ids before active run ids; TUI Esc uses session-scoped abort.
What was not tested: Live PTY mid-run provider turn with credentials (can add if required for merge).

## Notes for reviewers

Addresses steipete CHANGES_REQUESTED: no retain-controller-across-wait, no unauthorized full-queue clear, ordered session abort, owner-aware queued identity, TUI still forwards rather than inventing a second policy.
